### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. obsolete primary ciliary dyskinesia-retinitis pigmentosa syndrome  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.791)

**Proposed mechanism:** RPGR (HGNC:10295) —DISRUPTS→ Ciliary function and structure (GO:0005928); Ciliary function and structure (GO:0005928) —LEADS_TO→ Respiratory issues (HP:0011970); Ciliary function and structure (GO:0005928) —LEADS_TO→ Infertility (HP:0000789); RPGR (HGNC:10295) —DISRUPTS→ Photoreceptor function (GO:0000321); Photoreceptor function (GO:0000321) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal degeneration (HP:0000500). Mutations in RPGR (HGNC:10295) disrupt both ciliary function (leading to respiratory issues and infertility seen in primary ciliary dyskinesia) and photoreceptor function (leading to retinal degeneration in retinitis pigmentosa).

**How to falsify it:** Identification of individuals with pathogenic RPGR variants who are completely unaffected by either retinitis pigmentosa or primary ciliary dyskinesia phenotypes, or demonstration of distinct functional consequences of RPGR variants in the two disease contexts. _(variant: rs74315370)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared genetic basis in RPGR highlights potential for therapeutic strategies targeting ciliary function or photoreceptor maintenance that could benefit patients with both conditions.
